title: Config: what the config methods share
description: The definitions config-set, config-get and flush share: a value's path, a value, a change to make, a file written, and a conflict.

path.title: Path
path.description: A value's or a group's logical path, as keys from the top of config, such as ["actors", "tester", "runner"].

value.title: Value
value.description: A value, or a group of values as an object: any JSON but null.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Set the value or group at a path, or unset it. Exactly one of value and unset.

value.description: What to set: a value, or an object to set a whole group. Absent: the path is unset.

unset.description: Remove the value or group at the path. Absent: a value is given.

file.title: File
file.description: What a command did, or would do, to one config file.

path.description: The file, relative to the theatre's root.

action.description: write, remove, finish (a staged write troupe recorded and didn't finish) or discard (a staged write no change recorded).

kept.description: For a file forced past: the artifact its bytes were kept under. Absent: it wasn't forced past.

change.title: Conflicting change
change.description: One recorded change in a conflict, whole.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.description: Changes from lines of history that can't both hold.

rule.description: The rule they break together. Absent: they set the same values differently.
